subject: Dealing with missing Metadata Information- Bushnell Trophy Cam

messages.author: 700cf5b79e56c886
messages.subject: Dealing with missing Metadata Information- Bushnell Trophy Cam
parts:
Good morning everyone, 

  Another entry-level question but I can't find the answer- Bushnell Trophy Cameras HD do not save temperature and moon phase (mainly interested in temperature) in the metadata. How are you guys dealing with adding these data to the photos? I've tried modifying the metadata using Digikam, but haven't managed yet. Ideas?

Best,

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Dealing with missing Metadata Information- Bushnell Trophy Cam
parts:
Dear Mabel,
if the cameras did not record temperature it cannot be added. Or is temperature shown in the data field of the images?
Regarding moon phase, you may try one of the R packages that calculate it based on the record date (use the dates in the record table), e.g. the package "lunar" (never tried it). 
Regards,
Jürgen
